    Thought 7: Use the count of unique tokens to capture the diversity
    of language used in the query — queries with many unique tokens
    are more likely to be informative.
    Thought 8: Use the count of named entities to capture the presence

    Thought 9: Use the presence of specific TF-IDF terms to capture

    New Feature 8: entity_signal | ner_count / n_tokens
